kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَيْعَلَ • (ḥayʕala) Iq (non-past يُحَيْعِلُ (yuḥayʕilu), verbal noun حَيْعَلَة (ḥayʕala))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Blend of حَيَّ (ḥayya) + عَلَى (ʕalā), from the first two words in the sentence حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاة (ḥayya ʕalā ṣ-ṣalāh, “hasten to the prayer”), a part of the adhan text.
g: to recite the sentence (حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاة) or (حي على الفلاح)
